how.title: HOW TO PLAY
how.body:
GOAL
Build the four top piles from Ace to King by suit.

TABLE
Stack cards in descending order, alternating red and black. Only Kings go into empty columns.

MOVE
Tap the deck to draw. Drag cards, or tap a card then its target. Double-tap to send an eligible card to a top pile.

FREE HELP
Each deal includes {hints} free hints and {undos} free undos. The numbers on the buttons show what remains. DRAW 1 / 3 starts a new deal.
